//exclude: .next is excluded deliberately, and both halves matter. Dropping it from `include` is not enough on its own because `**/*.ts` matches inside it, so it has to be excluded outright. The generated route types in .next/types were never checked by CI anyway -- ci.yml runs typecheck before build, so the directory does not exist at that point and the include matched nothing. Locally the directory does exist, and a copy left over from before a Next upgrade fails against the current route signature, which blocked every commit once the pre-commit hook started running typecheck. `next build` typechecks the app itself and next.config sets no ignoreBuildErrors, so CI still covers these types where it counts.
